title: Runaway/hung subagent: reap + post-mortem when the kill-switch is pace-blocked
desc: A delegated subagent can run away burning TOKENS (not CPU) in a guard-cascade/escaping retry loop, invisible to wkjobs. TaskStop+ToolSearch are pace-blocked over-budget (backwards-gate), so the AI cannot self-reap; use wkhippo as a pace-exempt X-ray + FleetView human-stop. Post-mortem via bounded grep.
steps: PREVENTION: dispatch cheap agents with a TIGHT exit criterion + a fallback ladder so they do not loop forever on a mis-quoted edit; prefer the PROVEN approach over re-deriving (a265 looped on the exact wkedit pipe/quote-escaping the dispatcher had already solved a cleaner way). Cluster/Next: harness-pace-guard (step5 backwards-gate + the fix), hippocampus-living-memory-howto (wkhippo recent + session-id keyword X-ray + export/cwd gaps), wkjobs-ai-process-monitor (CPU-only, misses token-hippos), pace-deadlock-escapes-harness-editable-and-jisikhwa-free (wk-launcher escapes), wk-pstest, claude-code-agent-tier-routing (parallel-fleet caps).
